_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate plus flat funding and dead velocity make HOLD the graded call; no breaker visible to force Hope or Complacency.
next_move.brains_agree: No—analyst firm HOLD/Disbelief; narrative silent on forward phase and only notes metals strength, so split on framing not on an opposite signal
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 55-62 with funding still near flat and retail velocity/ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 70 with funding and retail velocity expanding, or a vol-led sell drives Fear & Greed below 54
